description: She wears a blue-teal floor-length patterned coat-dress with a fitted bodice and low square neckline. Gold woven borders and animal-like curling motifs decorate the bodice, sleeves and long skirt panels. Circular metal clasps sit near the shoulder straps. A broad decorated brown and gold belt with round fastenings and hanging metal ornaments secures the waist. A pale ivory wrap drapes around the forearms and down both sides. An ivory patterned underdress shows through the front opening, above dark blue boots with gold woven patterns. Gold tassel earrings add jewelry. No headgear or armor is present.
